main_text.p: quærentia, cum nemo sit qui verbis ea explicare, ac ne cogitatione quidem assequi possit, suæ relinquimus impietati & blasphemiæ curiositati, salutisque periculo non dubio.
main_text.head: XXVI.
main_text.p: Nam hoc magnum pietatis mysterium non est subiectum communi naturæ ordini: sed ratio eius in virtute Christi est, scientia in fide, causa in potestate, & effectus in voluntate eiusdem.
main_text.head: XXVII.
main_text.p: Sic vnio quoq; ipsa panis & corporis Christi est incomprehensibilis: quia non est personalis, neq; naturalis, neq; formalis, sed sacramentalis & supernaturalis.
main_text.head: XXVIII.
main_text.p: Non enim includitur corpus Christi in panem localiter, neque modo naturali, sed præsens est realiter & substantialiter.
main_text.head: XXIX.
main_text.p: Neque etiam verborum sono corpus Christi de cælo detrahitur, neque nouum corpus fingitur, sed verum ac viuum corpus Christi statuitur in cœna præsens realiter, substantialiter & naturaliter.
main_text.head: XXX.
main_text.p: Communicantes ergo firmissima fide percipimus, & ore manducamus verum corpus & verum sanguinem Christi, admirando & adorando tantummodo.
main_text.head: XXXI.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred and some words near the right edge are partly obscured; readings such as "quærentia" and "impietati" are best readings. Running head read as "PROPOSITVM VSCVLI" from the faded heading. Ends with a heading XXXI whose text is on the following page.
